[Act: limitation
 Chapter: First Division · Part X · Suits for Which There Is No Prescribed Period
 Section: 113::Three years.

Any suit for which no period of limitation is provided elsewhere in this Schedule.
Period of limitationThree years.
Time from which period begins to runWhen the right to sue accrues.
